engineApi.name: openDB
engineApi.description: Open/upgrade IndexedDB 'fishapp' v3 (stores tiles, spots, tracks, areas, catches, trips). Await at boot.

engineApi.name: idb
engineApi.description: get/getAll/put/del/count returning promises; writes resolve on transaction commit, reject on abort (quota).

engineApi.name: loadTileKeys
engineApi.description: Background build of the in-memory TileKeys index (fast path for not-stored tiles).

engineApi.name: deleteTilesByPrefix
engineApi.description: One-time migration flush of a layer prefix (e.g. 'gmrt/'); always resolves.

engineApi.name: makeLayer
engineApi.description: Create an OfflineTileLayer for a LAYERS id (used by the map/layers engine).

engineApi.name: LAYERS
engineApi.description: Layer catalogue (ids, zoom limits, tile sizes, urlFor, attribution).

engineApi.name: estimate
engineApi.description: {count, jobsLen, mb, tooBig, minZ, maxZ} recomputed on panel open, map moveend while open, and detail-level change.

engineApi.name: updateEstimate
engineApi.description: Recompute estimate from current map bounds/zoom, selected maxZ and active layer prefs (count before allocating).

engineApi.name: progress
engineApi.description: {running, done, total, failed, pct, phase:'idle'|'tiles'|'pack', statusText} for the progress UI; start button disabled while running.

engineApi.name: startDownload
engineApi.description: Preflight checks, persist(), 6-worker tile download with quota stop, area pack capture, area record write, toasts; always resets in finally.

engineApi.name: cancelDownload
engineApi.description: Set DL.cancelled; workers stop picking new jobs; a '(partial)' area record is written.

engineApi.name: areas
engineApi.description: AreaRecord[] (sorted ts desc in UI) with name, bounds, tiles, bytes, data, incomplete.

engineApi.name: deleteArea
engineApi.description: Confirm, delete the area's recomputed tile keys in 2000-key chunks, then the record; refresh packs, list, storage.

engineApi.name: flyToArea
engineApi.description: closePanels, setFollow(false), mapProgrammatic(fitBounds(area.bounds)).

engineApi.name: storageInfo
engineApi.description: {usedMB, quotaGB, tiles} or null when unsupported/error.

engineApi.name: refreshStorageInfo
engineApi.description: navigator.storage.estimate + idb.count('tiles').

engineApi.name: areaPackFor
engineApi.description: Newest area record with data whose bounds contain a point (for First Mate).

engineApi.name: areaPackSummary
engineApi.description: JSON summary of a pack for the get_area_intel AI tool; plus readers areaFcstIndex, areaDailyForecast, areaTidesNext, areaSstStats, areaDepthAt.

engineApi.name: areaDataRefresh
engineApi.description: Reload AreaData.packs from IDB after an area is saved or deleted.

engineApi.name: spots
engineApi.description: Spot[] {id, lat, lng, name, type, notes, ts}; UI sorts by distance from gps.lastLatLng else ts desc.

engineApi.name: editing
engineApi.description: Spot or {lat,lng,name?,type?,notes?} being edited; modal open when non-null; isNew = no id.

engineApi.name: openSpotModal
engineApi.description: Open modal for new (lat/lng, optional prefills) or existing spot. Called from Mark tab, map long-press, inspect popup, reef popup, spot popup Edit.

engineApi.name: saveSpotFromModal
engineApi.description: Persist {name (default 'Spot N+1'), type, notes, ts preserved}; replace marker; toast 'Spot saved ðŸ“Œ'; close modal.

engineApi.name: closeSpotModal
engineApi.description: Hide modal, clear editing.

engineApi.name: deleteSpot
engineApi.description: Delete record, marker, list entry (confirm happens in UI). Also used by First Mate delete_waypoint.

engineApi.name: flyToSpot
engineApi.description: closePanels, setFollow(false), mapProgrammatic(setView(ll, max(zoom,14))), open marker popup.

engineApi.name: navigateToSpot
engineApi.description: Close popup and gotoStart({lat,lng}, name).

engineApi.name: createSpot
engineApi.description: asstCreateSpot equivalent (no modal) used by First Mate and voice; awaits write.

engineApi.name: exportBackup
engineApi.description: Download fishapp-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json with spots, tracks, catches, trips, areas (no data); toast counts.

engineApi.name: importBackup
engineApi.description: Validate JSON + app marker, dedupe-merge 4 stores, toast result, always resync spots/tracks/catches/trips state.

engineApi.name: reefs
engineApi.description: Reef[] {n, la, lo, d?, c?} and loaded flag.

engineApi.name: reefsVisible / mpaVisible
engineApi.description: Layer visibility, persisted in fishapp.layers (reefs/mpa default true).

engineApi.name: setReefsVisible / setMpaVisible
engineApi.description: Add/remove reef marker group or MPA polygon group; persist prefs; also needed by First Mate toggle_layer (replaces synthetic change events on #ovl-reefs/#ovl-mpa).

engineApi.name: flyToReef
engineApi.description: closePanels, setFollow(false), ensure reef layer visible, mapProgrammatic(setView(ll, max(zoom,14))).

engineApi.name: saveReefAsSpot
engineApi.description: Close popup, openSpotModal({lat, lng, name, type:'wreck', notes:'{d} ft. {c}'}).

engineApi.name: toast
engineApi.description: All user-facing result messages (verbatim strings in spec section 4).

engineApi.name: confirm
engineApi.description: Blocking confirmation for spot/area deletes; nothing happens unless confirmed.

engineApi.name: onFix -> refreshSpotDistances
engineApi.description: Re-sort/re-render spots list only while the Spots panel is open, throttled to 3 s and 5 m movement.

engineApi.name: moveend -> updateEstimate
engineApi.description: Only while the Offline charts panel is open.

crossDeps: download.js uses window._map (app.js), toast/closePanels (app.js), setFollow/mapProgrammatic (gps.js), escapeHtml (spots.js), buildAreaPack/areaDataRefresh (areadata.js), LAYERS (tiles.js), idb/tileKey/getTileBlob/putTileBlob/deleteTiles (db.js)
download.js activeLayerIds reads Layers-panel DOM owned by app.js: input[name=base]:checked, #ovl-enc, #ovl-seamark
app.js calls updateEstimate on map moveend when #panel-download is open and on dlzoom change; wires #btn-dl-start/#btn-dl-cancel (sets DL.cancelled)

app.js boot: await openDB, loadTileKeys (not awaited), deleteTilesByPrefix('gmrt/') gated by localStorage fishapp.reliefSource, makeLayer for all chart layers, reefsInit then reefsSetVisible from fishapp.layers prefs, areaDataInit, spotsInit
tiles.js OfflineTileLayer uses tileKey/getTileBlob/putTileBlob/TileKeys/tileKeysReady (db.js) and global fetch wrapped with 30 s timeout (app.js)
areadata.js uses idb (db.js), nearestTideStation (tides.js, needs tidesInit loaded), FISH_TAXA (fish.js), Reefs.reefs (reefs.js), nmBetween (gps.js), L.latLng

assistant.js reads Spots.all, pushes into it and calls addSpotMarker/renderSpotsList/deleteSpot; uses idb.put('spots'); reads Reefs.reefs; calls areaPackFor/areaFcstIndex/areaDailyForecast/areaTidesNext/areaSstStats/areaDepthAt/areaPackSummary
assistant.js asstToolToggleLayer sets #ovl-reefs/#ovl-mpa .checked and dispatches change events (must become setReefsVisible/setMpaVisible actions)
gps.js gpsOnFix calls refreshSpotDistances() on every accepted fix
spots.js popup Go calls gotoStart (goto.js); spot/reef popups and lists use GPS.lastLatLng, nmBetween, bearingBetween (gps.js)
inspect.js tap popup 'ðŸ“Œ Save spot' calls openSpotModal; reefs.js uses queryPointData/windText/swellText/sstText/depthText (inspect.js)
escapeHtml (spots.js) is used by tracks.js, goto.js, fish.js, catch.js, bite.js, assistant.js, download.js, reefs.js
idb (db.js) is used by tracks.js, goto.js, catch.js, assistant.js
sw.js precaches data/reefs-ca.json and data/mpa-ca.json; reefs/areadata fetch them by relative URL
safetyCritical: IDB writes resolve only on transaction commit; QuotaExceeded surfaces via tx.onabort -> rejection (db.js:30-48). Never report a spot/tile/area saved before commit.
db helpers return rejected promises instead of throwing synchronously when storage is unavailable (db.js:50-62).

putTileBlob propagates write failures and keeps TileKeys in sync (db.js:67-75); bulk download stops on quota and toasts 'âš ï¸ Storage full â€” saved N of M tiles. This area is incomplete.' (download.js:164,184,201-204).
Storage preflight with 15% headroom before downloading (download.js:131-144).
Count tiles before allocating the job array; refuse >30,000 tiles; estimate runs on every map move incl. GPS follow pans (download.js:53-65,106-112).
Download run wrapped in try/finally so running flag/progress/start button always reset (download.js:195-255).
Cancelled downloads still write a '(partial)' area record so orphan tiles stay deletable after persist() (download.js:234-246).
Area delete: tiles first in 2000-key commit-awaited chunks, then the record (download.js:285-286, db.js:113-133).
deleteTilesByPrefix always settles (boot splash hang) and the migration flag is written before it runs, un-awaited (db.js:97-102, app.js:53-61).

Tile key / grid parity with Leaflet for 512-px layers: key z = CSS zoom, x/y on grid z-1; urlFor subtracts 1 (BlueTopo level z-1 else HTTP 400; bbox via tileBBox3857(z-1)) (download.js:74-76, tiles.js:48-49,60,72,90,100,116).
BlueTopo blank tiles (<=3000 bytes, minBytes) are never cached by the live layer (tiles.js:159-164).
Tile failure/offline -> transparent EMPTY_TILE, no error image; offline skips network (tiles.js:143-151,168-177).
List fly-to buttons call setFollow(false) and move the map inside mapProgrammatic so auto-refollow does not yank the view back (download.js:276-278, spots.js:131-134, reefs.js:152-158).

MPA restriction colours/text and the disclaimer 'Always confirm current CA DFW regulations before fishing.' must survive verbatim; unknown MPA types default to orange 'Restricted â€” check regulations' (reefs.js:12-22,112-117).
Reef popup shows 'needs internet' immediately offline instead of a spinner (reefs.js:55,74).
Backup must include spots, tracks, catches, trips; export anchor appended to DOM and revoked after 4 s (spots.js:158-187).
Import: dedupe by stable identity, honest distinct failure toasts, always resync UI in finally (spots.js:189-254).
Escape all user/data strings inserted into HTML popups/divIcons (escapeHtml, spots.js:256-259).
Area-pack honesty: per-section *Error flags, fish.total from total_results, non-finite daily values -> null so an unknown day is never 'best' (areadata.js:60-64,99-103,214-237).
Spot distance list refresh throttled 3 s / 5 m and skipped when panel hidden; called on every GPS fix (spots.js:144-156).
risks: loadTileKeys sets tileKeysReady=true even if getAllKeys fails, so the fast path sends every tile to the network and stored tiles show blank offline (db.js:82-88, tiles.js:183) â€” recommend setting ready only on success.
deleteTiles removes keys from TileKeys before commit; an aborted chunk leaves tiles stored but invisible offline (db.js:128).
Bulk download ignores minBytes (download.js:175 uses size>0), storing BlueTopo blanks as successful tiles.
activeLayerIds diverges from what app.js shows: bluetint base downloads no labels and no blueshade; only gmrt gets reliefhi and gmrt/sat get labels (download.js:22-23 vs app.js:128,136-148).

Area bounds are re-read after the async storage estimate; a GPS-follow pan in between makes the recorded bounds differ from the downloaded tiles, so later deletion misses tiles (download.js:102 vs 156).
Deleting an area deletes all its computed tile keys even if shared with an overlapping area or browse cache, silently making the other area incomplete (download.js:282-285).
incomplete flag (failed>0) is stored but never shown; '(charts + data)' and âœ… toast appear even when every pack section failed (download.js:225,231).
Cancel is ignored once the pack phase starts; in-flight tile fetches finish; no per-tile retry in bulk download.

areaDailyForecast uses the UTC date as 'today' (toISOString), dropping local today in US evenings; areaFcstIndex has no max distance so expired packs report their last hour as now (areadata.js:201-209,238).
saveSpotFromModal has no try/catch and no re-entry guard: storage failure leaves the modal open silently; double-tap Save on a new spot writes two spots (spots.js:71-93).

renderReefsList shows 'No reef data loaded.' if opened before reefsInit resolves and never refreshes; reef-list âžœ sets #ovl-reefs without a change event so prefs.reefs is not persisted (reefs.js:132-134,154-157).
reefsInit().then applies boot-time prefs, overriding a toggle made during the load window (app.js:226-229).

window.confirm and blob-anchor downloads may not work in the native iOS WKWebView shell (fishapp:// scheme) unless WKUIDelegate confirm panel and WKDownload are implemented â€” deletes would silently no-op and export would produce no file.
First Mate toggle_layer drives #ovl-reefs/#ovl-mpa via synthetic DOM change events; React port must route it through store actions or the AI tool breaks.
IDB schema has no onblocked/onversionchange handlers; bumping DB_VER in the React build with an old tab open could block the upgrade.
Many cross-file globals (escapeHtml, idb, Spots, Reefs, area readers) are consumed by assistant.js and other groups; module boundaries must re-export them or those features break.
Import ignores backup version and never restores areas; catches dedupe key lacks species (name field absent).
topLevelSideEffects: db.js: declares DB_NAME/DB_VER, _db=null, TileKeys=new Set(), tileKeysReady=false (no I/O)
tiles.js: OfflineTileLayer = L.TileLayer.extend(...) at load â€” requires Leaflet loaded first (no I/O)
spots.js: SPOT_ICONS, Spots state object, _spotDistTs/_spotDistLL lets only
reefs.js: Reefs state object, MPA_STYLE table only
No listeners, timers or network/IDB calls run at script load in this group; all init is invoked from app.js init()
